Same-build profiled q8192/out32 is 61410.7381 ms with FP64 norms and 61402.9181 ms with scaled FP32 norms. No product gain is retained. The 1000 ppb selector and midpoint radii are unchanged. Per-stage HIP event intervals include scheduling and shared-stream overlap; they are diagnostics rather than isolated kernel throughput.
